# Implementing useMemo()

#### Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App

## Implementing useMemo()

The code below shows how we might implement useMemo() in our app:

```react
import { useState, useMemo } from "react";

const filteredEntries = useMemo(function () {
  if (!query.trim()) return entries;

  const lower = query.toLowerCase();

  return entries.filter(function (entry) {
    return (
      entry.title.toLowerCase().includes(lower) ||
      entry.content.toLowerCase().includes(lower)
    );
  });
}, [entries, query]);
```

How It Works

Between renders,

- If neither entries nor query has changed, React returns the cached value without calling the function at all.
- If either changes, it recomputes.
